query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS priceHistory (
  id INT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,
  companyId INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  branchId INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  productId INT NOT NULL,
  changeType ENUM('PRECO_VENDA', 'CUSTO_MEDIO') NOT NULL,
  channelId INT,
  previousValue DECIMAL(10,2),
  newValue DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL,
  changePercent DECIMAL(8,2),
  reason TEXT,
  userId VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
  userName VARCHAR(200),
  createdAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  INDEX ph_product_idx (productId),
  INDEX ph_change_type_idx (changeType),
  INDEX ph_channel_idx (channelId),
  INDEX ph_date_idx (createdAt),
  INDEX ph_company_branch_idx (companyId, branchId)
);
